currentCard.prompt: Какова одна из основных функций почек?

answers.note: Печень вырабатывает желчь и выделяет её в двенадцатиперстную кишку; желчный пузырь хранит и концентрирует её.
В каждой почке около 1,3 миллиона нефронов; они очищают кровь и балансируют состав кровотока.
В лёгких кислород и углекислый газ обмениваются с воздухом через дыхательную мембрану между альвеолами и капиллярами.
В тонкой кишке переваривание белков завершается при участии кишечного и панкреатического соков.

currentCard.explanation: Почки поддерживают водно-солевой баланс, возвращая воду и растворённые вещества из фильтрата в кровь. Около 99% фильтрата реабсорбируется; остаток выводится с мочой.

source.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: Gross Anatomy of the Kidney

literal.prompt: Какова одна из основных функций почек?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Kidney25.3 L41/L53/L55 combines sodium reabsorption, balancing circulating constituents and return of water/solutes; urine25.5 L32 explicitly identifies plasma-composition regulation. Thus water-salt balance is a main renal homeostatic function. Liver23.6 L31 assigns bile production/export to liver, lungs22.2 L31/L42-L44 assigns air-blood exchange to lungs, and intestine23.5 L99-L100 assigns enzymatic protein digestion to digestive system. Exactly slot1 is a kidney function among this row. The prompt asks one main function, not an exhaustive sole function. All four are plausible adult organ-function noun phrases without grammar/format cues.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Почки поддерживают водно-солевой баланс, возвращая воду и растворённые вещества из фильтрата в кровь. Около 99% фильтрата реабсорбируется; остаток выводится с мочой.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Kidney25.3 L55 explicitly returns most solutes/water from filtrate to circulation; L53 describes balancing constituents. Urine25.5 L32 and L53-L54 ground renal composition regulation and approximately99percent reabsorption; L64 identifies unrecovered filtrate as eliminated urine. «Около» preserves normal rounded physiology rather than an exact invariant. The explanation does not deny secretion (sourceL32) or claim urine is chemically unmodified initial filtrate; it describes bulk recovery/output. Two Russian sentences directly name kidneys.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Liver23.6 L31 explicitly says liver produces bile and exports it to duodenum, while gallbladder stores/concentrates/releases it. L45-L46 provides duct route and L58 between-meal diversion/storage. This note accurately separates production from storage for the actual bile-synthesis/export distractor, not a generic unrelated liver fact.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Kidney25.3 L51 states about1.3million nephrons in each kidney; L53 states that these functional units cleanse blood and balance constituents. «Около» retains approximation and «в каждой» preserves per-kidney rather than paired total. «Состав кровотока» is understood here as constituents of circulating blood, as in the source, not a claim of different flow velocity/composition physics. The nephron count and functional-unit identity add concrete own-kidney facts beyond the water-salt-balance prompt/key.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Intestine23.5 L99 directly says protein digestion, partially begun earlier, is completed in small intestine with intestinal/pancreatic juices; L100 explicitly discusses enzyme synthesis/digestion at mucosal surfaces. The note says «завершается» rather than claiming digestion starts only there or that kidneys secrete digestive enzymes. It is a concrete own-protein-digestion fact.
